findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now an abstract class and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed to subclass `StatefulDetectorHandler` with a bare `pass` body. `StatefulDetectorHandler` declares four abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`), none of which are implemented here, so the class remains abstract. It is still registered as `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler`, and `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates it via `group_type.detector_handler(self)`. For any `Detector` row with `type == "metric_alert_fire"`, that property (and therefore `process_detectors`) will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler ...` instead of returning a handler or logging and returning `None`. Previously the class was concrete (it returned `[]`). Either implement the abstract methods (even with stub bodies) or stop registering it as the group type's handler until it is implemented; there is also no test exercising this handler that would have caught the regression.

findings.title: Expected occurrence in TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe is built with the wrong group key
findings.body: In `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe`, the expected `IssueOccurrence` is built via `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, PriorityLevel.HIGH)`, but `evaluate_group_key_value` is invoked with `group_key="group_key"`. `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` uses `handler.build_fingerprint(group_key)`, so the expected fingerprint is `["<id>:val1"]` while the handler will produce `["<id>:group_key"]`. `IssueOccurrence` is a frozen dataclass with field-wise equality, so `DetectorEvaluationResult.__eq__` will compare these as unequal and the assertion `== expected_result` cannot pass as written (or, if it does pass, it indicates equality is not comparing what the test intends). The call should pass `expected_result.group_key` ("group_key") and the actual value (10) to the helper.

findings.title: evaluate() docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` was changed to return `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`, but its docstring still reads "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". Implementers reading the docstring will get the wrong contract; it should describe the dict keyed by group key.

findings.title: Stale TODO comment about becoming a stateful detector
findings.body: The comment `# TODO: This will be a stateful detector when we build that abstraction` is now inaccurate: the class directly subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` in this PR, so the abstraction exists and is already being used. The TODO should be removed or replaced with one describing the actual remaining work (implementing the abstract hooks).
